content.short: ROSEN is a micro-task marketplace where people earn globally doing jobs AI cannot do.
content.description: ROSEN connects people to paid micro-tasks, positioning itself as work that AI cannot do, with users in more than 200 countries and over 100,000 earning opportunities. It offers mobile apps and a mini app inside World App, listed in World's ecosystem directory.
content.meta: ROSEN is a global micro-task marketplace for human work, with a World App mini app.
